column1: # Fact registry — the mechanism against the same fact drifting across 6-7 notes.
# key <TAB> owner(note#heading) <TAB> restate_regex <TAB> severity
# A line matching restate_regex OUTSIDE the owner note must carry a pointer to
# the owner on that same line (a [[wikilink]] to it is enough). That keeps one
# canonical statement while still letting other notes assert the fact locally —
# which is cheaper for an agent than a transclusion it has to resolve.
# Regexes are case-insensitive. Keep them tight: a loose regex produces false
# positives, and a rule with false positives gets switched off within a day.
# NOTE on regex tightness (learned the hard way — the first pass fired 35 times):
# match the RULE'S PHRASING, never the type or field name. `numeric(38,0)` and
# `cryptoTxId` appear legitimately wherever schema is discussed; only "ніколи
# float" or a re-listing of the whole field set is an actual restatement.
